case_number: Criminal Appeal No 1231 of 2022 (Arising out of SLP(Crl) No 7426 of 2022)
summary: The appeal challenged the Allahabad High Court's dismissal of a Section 482 CrPC application seeking to quash an FIR and charge-sheet alleging rape under Section 376 IPC, based on a promise to marry. The key issue was whether sexual relations following a false promise to marry constitute rape under Section 375 IPC read with Section 90 IPC. The Supreme Court examined whether consent was vitiated by 'misconception of fact' due to a false promise, applying the standard that only a promise made with no intention of fulfilling it at the time it was made would vitiate consent. The Court emphasized that mere breach of a genuine promise to marry does not amount to rape. The High Court had declined to quash the proceedings, and the appeal was effectively dismissed as the Court found the allegations, if proven, could constitute an offence.
